summary_claims.claim: Bill designates AESIA by default, the data protection authorities, the CGPJ, Bank of Spain, CNMV and the DGSFP as market surveillance authorities (art. 5). Literal: 'The AESIA is designated as market surveillance authority of the following AI systems'.
Very serious infringements carry fines up to EUR 35,000,000 or 7 % of worldwide turnover (art. 30.1.a); repeal of RD 817/2023 in the single repealing provision.

note: La Moncloa referencias of 11 Mar 2025 and 26 May 2026 and the BOCG no. 97-1 of 12 Jun 2026 (file 121/000096; amendment deadline 30 Jun 2026) are stored and match. The record moves from anteproyecto to proyecto de ley orgánica of the same instrument; the title, official identifier and date_last_updated (26 May 2026) follow. Status stays Draft / proposed. The BOCG quotes count as secondary because congreso.es is not in official-sites.json; the La Moncloa quotes carry the level.
